quadratic-assembled-small.gauge_definition: remove one actual and one reference volume-weighted mean over ALL cells, no regional gauge removal
quadratic-assembled-small.scope: raw field/local spatial accuracy audit, no new solve or changed acceptance threshold
quadratic-assembled-small.window_selection: cell centroids inside fixed cylinders; no partial-cell clipping, hull-distance estimate, or regional gauge fit
quadratic-assembled-small.fixed_scale_diagnostic: RMS and maximum error divided by rho*U^2=0.25; not reference-relative L2, physical Cp, or a replacement acceptance gate
